name: Actualising foreign investment
note: Lift actualised FDI to 10% of GDP by 2030 and halve the gap between pledged and delivered investment, backed by ready-to-operate SEZs and a project preparation fund.

name: Deepening capital markets
note: Fully liberalise the capital account beyond the EAC and SADC by June 2027 and modernise trading, settlement and custody, so foreign investors hold at least half of local market capitalisation.

name: Deepening domestic credit
note: Banking reforms to keep non-performing loans below 5%, improve securitisation and lift private investment to 25 to 30% of GDP.

name: Credit Guarantee Corporation
note: A new Credit Guarantee Corporation of Tanzania to bridge collateral gaps, targeting TZS 7 billion in cumulative guarantees by June 2031.

name: Mass MSME formalisation
note: Register at least 250,000 MSMEs a year, lift their access to formal credit to 40% and expand credit-bureau coverage to 60% of adults by 2031.

name: Dar es Salaam International Financial Centre
note: Designating Dar es Salaam as an international financial centre to attract foreign portfolio investment.

name: Diaspora Direct Investment platforms
note: Connecting Tanzanian start-ups and MSMEs directly with the diaspora for equity and mentorship.

name: Youth Investment Windows
note: Dedicated windows inside financial institutions offering tailored products for young entrepreneurs.

name: Supply Chain Finance
note: Letting local suppliers borrow against confirmed purchase orders from international buyers.
